title: astragalus monspessulanus subsp. wulfenii
intro: Astragalus monspessulanus subsp. wulfenii, commonly known as Wulfen's milk-vetch, is a perennial legume plant species that belongs to the Astragalus genus. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as enhancing immune function, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Wulfen's milk-vetch include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents contribute to its ability to scavenge free radicals, modulate immune responses, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
